Isaya 41:13

"Usiogope, nitakusaidia."

Maneno haya BWANA mwenyewe anayatamka kwako — si ahadi ya mbali, bali ya karibu mno. Kama hofu inakufinya leo, jua kwamba Yeye aliyekuumba yu pembeni yako, tayari kushika mkono wako na kukusaidia.

#Isaya #Usiogope #MunguMsaidizi #Imani #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

Lamentations 3:22

"The faithful love of the LORD never ends! His mercies never cease."

Every new morning is quiet proof that God's mercy has not run out on you. Whatever yesterday held, His compassion meets you fresh today — great is His faithfulness.

#Lamentations #MercyOfGod #FaithfulLove #NewMercies #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

"Msifadhaike mioyoni mwenu; mnamwamini Mungu, niaminini na mimi."

Akifahamu kabisa jinsi mioyo yetu inavyoweza kufadhaika kirahisi, Yesu hututangulizia amani yake ya ndani hata kabla ya majaribu. Mkabidhi Bwana Yesu imani yako kamili leo, na moyo wako utafurahia amani isiyoelezeka inayopita ufahamu wote.
